gold_reason: Gold held a modest gain after the Federal Reserve kept interest rates steady

lead_story: The Fed's decision to hold interest rates steady has sparked doubts about its ability to act on inflation, leading to a divided response from officials and investors. The decision has also led to a decline in the value of the dollar. As a result, investors are now awaiting fresh economic data to determine their next moves.
